body.name: cumulant-SVD quotient GMM
body.construction: Construct \(\widehat c_k\) and \(\widehat m_k\) from symmetrized unbiased cumulant U-statistics, set \(\widehat C=[\widehat c_2\mid\cdots\mid\widehat c_{d+1}]\), let \(\widehat Q\) be the orthogonal complement projector from the rank-\(d\) SVD of \(\widehat C\), and set \(\widehat\beta\in\arg\min_{b\in[-B,B]}\max_{d+2\le k\le R_{\max}}\lVert\widehat Q(\widehat m_k-b\widehat c_k)\rVert_2\).
